interfaces.name: authorization.Authorizer
interfaces.semantics: The caller constructs the complete typed request; errors, NotApplicable, and invalid outcomes fail closed and MUST NOT be converted to Allow.

interfaces.name: authorization.Service
interfaces.semantics: Service is the consumer-oriented decision boundary; errors, stale revisions, NotApplicable and invalid outcomes deny authority.

interfaces.name: authorization.AuthorizationService
interfaces.semantics: The exact externally owned administrative operation boundary; every method uses its closed request, result and stable error contracts and preserves unknown outcomes.

types.declaration: enum{authorization.AssignmentDispositionUnspecified,authorization.AssignmentDispositionReject,authorization.AssignmentDispositionRemove,authorization.AssignmentDispositionReassign}
types.name: authorization.AssignmentDisposition
types.semantics: Unspecified is invalid; Remove deletes every affected assignment and Reassign requires one explicit replacement role, with at most 10000 affected assignments.

types.declaration: struct{AssignmentCount uint32; SubjectCount uint32; Truncated bool}
types.name: authorization.AssignmentImpact
types.semantics: Counts are bounded to 10000 and describe the exact pre-mutation impact; Truncated is forbidden for an authorized mutation decision.

types.declaration: struct{Attribute authorization.AttributeName; Operator authorization.ConditionOperator; Value authorization.Value}
types.name: authorization.Condition
types.semantics: Attribute and Operator are required; Value uses the existing bounded closed authorization value union, and evaluation never performs implicit string conversion.

types.declaration: enum{authorization.ConditionOperatorUnspecified,authorization.ConditionOperatorEqual,authorization.ConditionOperatorNotEqual,authorization.ConditionOperatorContains,authorization.ConditionOperatorLess,authorization.ConditionOperatorGreater}
types.name: authorization.ConditionOperator
types.semantics: Unspecified is invalid and operands must have the exact compatible authorization.Value kind.

types.declaration: struct{Subject authorization.Subject; Action authorization.Action; Resource authorization.Resource; Tenant authorization.TenantID; Environment authorization.Environment; Attributes authorization.Attributes}
types.name: authorization.Request
types.semantics: Subject kind and ID, action, and resource type are mandatory; an empty tenant is explicitly global and never implies authorization.

types.declaration: struct{Request authorization.Request; CorrelationID string; PolicyRevision authorization.Revision}
types.name: authorization.DecisionContext
types.semantics: Request is fully validated, CorrelationID is optional and bounded to 128 UTF-8 bytes, and a positive PolicyRevision binds the decision to one immutable policy snapshot.

types.declaration: struct{Outcome authorization.Outcome; Reason authorization.ReasonCode; MatchedPolicyIDs []authorization.PolicyID; MatchedPolicyIDsTruncated bool; Revision authorization.Revision; Trace []authorization.TraceEntry; TraceTruncated bool}
types.name: authorization.Decision
types.semantics: Outcome is exactly NotApplicable, Allow, or Deny; the decision records the policy revision and bounded/truncation-aware evidence without request attribute values.

types.declaration: defined string; 1..128 canonical ASCII characters
types.name: authorization.PermissionID
types.semantics: Stable permission identity; empty is invalid, comparison is bytewise, and no prefix or wildcard grants authority.

types.declaration: struct{PermissionID authorization.PermissionID; ResourceType authorization.ResourceType; ResourceID authorization.ResourceID; Action authorization.Action; Conditions []authorization.Condition}
types.name: authorization.PermissionStatement
types.semantics: PermissionID, ResourceType and Action are required; ResourceID may select the whole type; Conditions is canonically ordered, duplicate-free and limited to 64 entries.

types.declaration: enum{authorization.RoleDispositionUnspecified,authorization.RoleDispositionReject,authorization.RoleDispositionDetach,authorization.RoleDispositionReplace}
types.name: authorization.RoleDisposition
types.semantics: Unspecified is invalid; Detach removes at most 256 roles and Replace requires one explicit replacement role and preserves no hidden permissions.

types.declaration: struct{RoleID authorization.RoleID; Name string; StatementIDs []authorization.StatementID; Version uint64}
types.name: authorization.Role
types.semantics: RoleID is immutable, Name is 1..128 valid NFC UTF-8 bytes without leading/trailing whitespace or control characters, StatementIDs is bytewise sorted, duplicate-free, defensively copied and limited to 256 entries, and Version is positive; authority derives only from the exact current statements, never the role name.

types.declaration: defined string; exactly 22 canonical base64url characters
types.name: authorization.StatementID
types.semantics: Stable permission-statement identity scoped to the authorization authority; empty is invalid and it conveys no permission by itself.

types.declaration: struct{Subject authorization.Subject; Roles []string; StatementIDs []authorization.StatementID; Revision authorization.Revision}
types.name: authorization.SubjectProjection
types.semantics: Roles and StatementIDs are bytewise sorted and duplicate-free, bounded to 128 and 256 entries respectively, and Revision is positive; returned slices are defensive copies.

types.declaration: struct{StatementID authorization.StatementID; Statement authorization.PermissionStatement; Version uint64}
types.name: authorization.VersionedPermissionStatement
types.semantics: Version is positive and fences replacement or deletion; StatementID equals the immutable identity of Statement.

types.declaration: struct{Actor authorization.Subject; Context authorization.DecisionContext}
types.name: authorization.AdminPermissionCheckRequest
types.semantics: Actor is the requesting administrator supplied by trusted composition; Context.Request is the independently evaluated subject/resource/action and exact policy revision. Both subjects are complete; authentication grants no authority.

types.declaration: struct{Decision authorization.Decision}
types.name: authorization.AdminPermissionCheckResult
types.semantics: Decision is explicit allow or deny with policy identity and version; role-name inference is forbidden.

types.declaration: opaque struct with unexported kind and retryAfter; *AdminPermissionCheckError implements error
types.name: authorization.AdminPermissionCheckError
types.semantics: Exactly seven operation-specific tags. Zero and unknown tags are invalid; RetryAfter is 1 second..1 hour only for rate limiting and zero otherwise. No conflict or commit outcome; errors are redacted.

types.declaration: struct{Actor authorization.Subject; Target authorization.Subject; RoleIDs []authorization.RoleID; PermissionIDs []authorization.StatementID; ExpectedVersion uint64; IdempotencyKey authorization.IdempotencyKey}
types.name: authorization.AdminUserRoleSetRequest
types.semantics: Actor is the requesting administrator; Target is the exact complete user subject. Ordered duplicate-free roles/statements have maxima 128/256 and may be empty to clear assignments. Positive expected version and exact opaque key bind retries to all request fields; scope, atomic persistence and reconciliation belong to the consuming authority.

types.declaration: struct{Decision authorization.Decision; Projection authorization.SubjectProjection; AuthorityVersion uint64}
types.name: authorization.AdminUserRoleSetResult
types.semantics: Deny carries no projection or authority version. Allow carries the exact target's valid complete projection with revision equal to committed AuthorityVersion, strictly greater than the requested expected version; validation does not certify durable atomicity.

types.declaration: opaque struct with unexported kind, retryAfter and commandID; *AdminUserRoleSetError implements error
types.name: authorization.AdminUserRoleSetError
types.semantics: Exactly nine operation-specific tags. Zero, unknown tags and extraneous payloads are invalid; only rate limiting carries 1 second..1 hour delay and only unknown commit carries a canonical nonzero CommandID. Unknown outcome requires reconciliation, never a new mutation attempt.

types.declaration: defined string; 1..128 canonical ASCII characters
types.name: authorization.RoleID
types.semantics: Same exact bounded ASCII grammar as PermissionID; zero invalid, identity confers no permission.

types.declaration: defined string; exactly 22 canonical unpadded base64url characters encoding 16 bytes
types.name: authorization.CommandID
types.semantics: Stable administrative attempt identity; zero and noncanonical trailing bits are invalid.

types.declaration: opaque struct with unexported raw string
types.name: authorization.IdempotencyKey
types.semantics: Copies exactly 1..256 input bytes into immutable storage. Zero invalid. Formatting and slog redact; JSON/text serialization reject. Retain only keyed digests and discard transient raw references; no physical erasure guarantee. Digest and BindingDigest require a 32..64 byte authority key; BindingDigest binds all request fields and the authority owns tenant/key scope.

types.declaration: enum{authorization.AdminPermissionCheckInvalidInput,authorization.AdminPermissionCheckUnauthenticated,authorization.AdminPermissionCheckForbidden,authorization.AdminPermissionCheckRateLimited,authorization.AdminPermissionCheckUnavailable,authorization.AdminPermissionCheckCancelled,authorization.AdminPermissionCheckDeadlineExceeded}
types.name: authorization.AdminPermissionCheckErrorKind
types.semantics: Defined uint8; tags start at 1. Zero and unknown tags are invalid.

types.declaration: enum{authorization.AdminUserRoleSetInvalidInput,authorization.AdminUserRoleSetUnauthenticated,authorization.AdminUserRoleSetForbidden,authorization.AdminUserRoleSetConflict,authorization.AdminUserRoleSetRateLimited,authorization.AdminUserRoleSetUnavailable,authorization.AdminUserRoleSetCancelled,authorization.AdminUserRoleSetDeadlineExceeded,authorization.AdminUserRoleSetUnknownCommit}
types.name: authorization.AdminUserRoleSetErrorKind
types.semantics: Defined uint8; tags start at 1. Zero and unknown tags are invalid.
